QuestInfo.name: Thistles and Thorns
QuestInfo.0:
You depart to the Eternal Forest with the Spirit Guides. 
But #rBrambles#k are blocking the way. You need to pass through here to get to the spring... 

What's going on?
QuestInfo.1:
Put the Brambles to rest. Taking care of around #r30#k will allow you to pass through.
There's no time to delay. The last Spirit Guide could be in danger.
QuestInfo.2:
You couldn't go straight to the spring, as the #rBrambles#k were blocking you.

Penni thinks there's a malicious force, somewhere in the woods, determined to stop you.

You are worried about the last Spirit Guide. Find them quickly.
